shipping_guide.title: How to ship your artwork
shipping_guide.pack_body: Protect the corners with corner guards or cardboard, wrap the artwork in bubble wrap and put it in a sturdy box so it can’t slide around. If it has glass, tape a cross over the glass so the shards stay in place if it breaks.
shipping_guide.label_body: Measure and weigh the parcel and buy shipping from a carrier, usually right in their app. Choose a service with tracking so the buyer can follow the parcel. You’ll find the buyer’s address on the order below, with a button to copy it.
shipping_guide.drop_body: Drop the parcel at a service point or parcel locker. Keep the receipt until the buyer has the artwork.
shipping_guide.tracking_body: Mark the order as shipped and enter the tracking number. The buyer gets an email, and you get paid once the buyer has received the artwork (or automatically 14 days after you shipped).
shipping_guide.insurance_note: Tip: regular parcels are only insured up to a certain amount. For an expensive artwork, add extra insurance or use a valuable-parcel service.

about.title: About Konstbyte
about.heading: A place where art lives on
about.intro: Konstbyte is a place where creativity is given space and where art lives on in new homes. We believe art should be accessible, inspiring and easy — both to discover and to share.
about.community_text: Established artists, hobby creators and curious buyers gather here in a safe and warm environment. Our vision is to create a marketplace that feels personal, human and free from unnecessary obstacles. A place where you can find something unique, or let your own creations reach more people.

pillars.text: Make it easier to sell and buy art without hassle
Highlight both new and experienced creators
Create a community where inspiration and creativity can flow
Give artworks a longer life and new contexts

about.closing_1: Whether you paint, photograph, sculpt or simply love surrounding yourself with beautiful things — you are welcome here.
about.closing_2: Konstbyte is for those who want to discover, create, be inspired — and pass it on.

seller.heading: Do you sell as a private person or as a business?
seller.desc: Buyers have different rights depending on who they buy from, so it is shown on your listings. You are responsible for it being correct.
seller.private_desc: You sell your own art now and then, not as a business. The buyer has no statutory right of withdrawal.
seller.business_desc: You sell as a business, for example as a sole trader or with F-tax. The buyer then has a 14-day right of withdrawal and can complain about faults, and you are responsible for that.
